description: Curated scholarship dataset for the Career & Scholarship Advisor RAG system.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.eligibility: International students with a bachelor's degree, strong academic record, and English proficiency.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, living stipend, health insurance, and airfare.
scholarships.deadline: Annual deadlines vary by country; typically May-October.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply through the U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission in your home country.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience and leadership potential.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, travel costs, and visa fees.
scholarships.deadline: Applications open in August and close in November.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply online at chevening.org and submit two reference letters.

scholarships.name: DAAD Scholarship Programme
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates from developing and emerging countries with at least two years of professional experience.
scholarships.benefits: Monthly stipend, travel allowance, health insurance, and tuition coverage.
scholarships.deadline: Varies by programme; usually October-December for the following academic year.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply through the DAAD portal and upload degree transcripts and work certificates.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students worldwide with a relevant bachelor's degree; recent graduates and professionals welcome.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, travel costs, and installation costs.
scholarships.deadline: Most programmes close between January and March.
scholarships.next_steps: Select a programme on the Erasmus Mundus catalogue and apply directly to the consortium.

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of participating developing countries with minimum academic requirements and English proficiency.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, and living expenses.
scholarships.deadline: Applications usually open 1 February and close 30 April.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply through the Australia Awards website in your home country.

scholarships.name: Türkiye Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: International students from any country with strong academic achievement.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, and one-year Turkish language course.
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in January and close in February.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of Commonwealth developing countries who cannot afford UK study.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, living allowance, travel, and thesis grant.
scholarships.deadline: Applications open in November and close in December.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply to a participating UK university and the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission.

scholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.eligibility: International students under 30 for Masters and under 35 for PhD, nominated by a French institution.
scholarships.benefits: Monthly allowance, travel, health insurance, and cultural activities.
scholarships.deadline: Applications open in October and close in January.
scholarships.next_steps: Contact your chosen French institution to nominate you.

scholarships.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Holders of a university degree from any country, accepted by a Swiss professor or institution.
scholarships.benefits: Monthly stipend, tuition fee waiver, health insurance, and airfare.
scholarships.deadline: Deadlines vary by Swiss embassy; typically September-December.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply through the Swiss Embassy in your country.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK applying to the University of Cambridge.
scholarships.benefits: Full cost of study at Cambridge, maintenance allowance, travel, and discretionary funding.
scholarships.deadline: US deadline: October; international deadline: December.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply for admission to Cambridge and indicate Gates Cambridge in the funding section.

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
scholarships.eligibility: International students under 25 for undergraduate, with strong academic record and Japanese language interest.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend (~117,000 JPY), round-trip airfare, and one-year Japanese language preparatory course.
scholarships.deadline: Embassy recommendation applications open in April; university recommendation in January.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply through the Japanese Embassy in your country or via a recommending Japanese university.

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
scholarships.provider: China Scholarship Council, Ministry of Education of China
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with required academic qualifications; age under 25 for bachelor's.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation, monthly living allowance, and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open December and close March for the following September intake.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply online at campuschina.org or through the Chinese Embassy in your home country (Type A) or directly to a Chinese university (Type B).

scholarships.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: International secondary school students with exceptional academic achievement and leadership; nominated by their school.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition for four years, books, incidental fees, and full residence support.
scholarships.deadline: School nomination deadline in November; student application in December.
scholarships.next_steps: Ask your school counsellor to nominate you, then apply to University of Toronto as an international student.

scholarships.name: Stamps Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Stamps Family Charitable Foundation (via partner U.S. universities)
scholarships.eligibility: Exceptional high school students applying to a partner university; strong academics, leadership, and community service.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, room and board, and an enrichment fund of up to $10,000 for research, study abroad, or internships.
scholarships.deadline: Varies by partner university; typically December-January.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply to a Stamps partner university (e.g., University of Michigan, USC, Georgia Tech) and indicate Stamps in your application.

scholarships.name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own country; strong academic record required.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition and college fees, plus a living costs grant for the duration of the course.
scholarships.deadline: Applications close in January via UCAS.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply to Oxford through UCAS, then submit a separate Reach Oxford Scholarship application.

scholarships.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.eligibility: Talented young people from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, primarily in Africa, with strong academic performance and leadership.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition, accommodation, books, living stipend, and mentorship support.
scholarships.deadline: Varies by partner university; typically December-February.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply to a Mastercard Foundation partner university (e.g., University of Toronto, Sciences Po, UC Berkeley) and indicate the Scholars Program.

scholarships.name: KAIST International Student Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
scholarships.eligibility: International students with outstanding academic records; no Korean language requirement for English-taught programs.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition waiver, monthly allowance (~350,000 KRW), dormitory, and medical insurance.
scholarships.deadline: Fall intake applications close in January; spring intake in July.
scholarships.next_steps: Apply online at kaist.ac.kr and submit academic transcripts, recommendation letters, and a personal statement.
